chk_action_intents_expiry.name: chk_action_intents_expiry
chk_action_intents_expiry.value: unixepoch("action_intents"."expires_at") IS NOT NULL AND unixepoch("action_intents"."expires_at") > unixepoch("action_intents"."created_at")

chk_approval_grants_expiry.name: chk_approval_grants_expiry
chk_approval_grants_expiry.value: unixepoch("approval_grants"."expires_at") IS NOT NULL AND unixepoch("approval_grants"."approved_at") IS NOT NULL AND unixepoch("approval_grants"."expires_at") > unixepoch("approval_grants"."approved_at")

chk_context_snapshots_state_time.name: chk_context_snapshots_state_time
chk_context_snapshots_state_time.value: ("context_snapshots"."current_state" = 'collecting' AND "context_snapshots"."frozen_at" IS NULL) OR ("context_snapshots"."current_state" IN ('frozen', 'superseded') AND unixepoch("context_snapshots"."frozen_at") IS NOT NULL)

chk_effect_attempt_events_response_hash.name: chk_effect_attempt_events_response_hash
chk_effect_attempt_events_response_hash.value: "effect_attempt_events"."provider_response_hash" IS NULL OR (length("effect_attempt_events"."provider_response_hash") = 64 AND "effect_attempt_events"."provider_response_hash" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')

chk_outcome_definitions_window.name: chk_outcome_definitions_window
chk_outcome_definitions_window.value: unixepoch("outcome_definitions"."window_starts_at") IS NOT NULL AND unixepoch("outcome_definitions"."window_ends_at") IS NOT NULL AND unixepoch("outcome_definitions"."window_starts_at") < unixepoch("outcome_definitions"."window_ends_at")

chk_outcome_observations_truth_signature.name: chk_outcome_observations_truth_signature
chk_outcome_observations_truth_signature.value: ("outcome_observations"."truth_mode" = 'FIXTURE' AND "outcome_observations"."signature_status" IN ('fixture', 'invalid')) OR ("outcome_observations"."truth_mode" IN ('LIVE', 'TEST') AND "outcome_observations"."signature_status" IN ('verified', 'invalid'))

chk_reasoning_nodes_output_hash.name: chk_reasoning_nodes_output_hash
chk_reasoning_nodes_output_hash.value: "reasoning_nodes"."output_hash" IS NULL OR (length("reasoning_nodes"."output_hash") = 64 AND "reasoning_nodes"."output_hash" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')

chk_reasoning_nodes_state_payload.name: chk_reasoning_nodes_state_payload
chk_reasoning_nodes_state_payload.value:
(
        "reasoning_nodes"."current_state" = 'pending'
        AND "reasoning_nodes"."started_at" IS NULL
        AND "reasoning_nodes"."completed_at" IS NULL
        AND "reasoning_nodes"."output_hash" IS NULL
        AND "reasoning_nodes"."error_code" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "reasoning_nodes"."current_state" = 'running'
        AND "reasoning_nodes"."started_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "reasoning_nodes"."completed_at" IS NULL
        AND "reasoning_nodes"."output_hash" IS NULL
        AND "reasoning_nodes"."error_code" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "reasoning_nodes"."current_state" = 'succeeded'
        AND "reasoning_nodes"."started_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "reasoning_nodes"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "reasoning_nodes"."output_hash" IS NOT NULL
        AND "reasoning_nodes"."error_code" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "reasoning_nodes"."current_state" = 'failed'
        AND "reasoning_nodes"."started_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "reasoning_nodes"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "reasoning_nodes"."output_hash" IS NULL
        AND "reasoning_nodes"."error_code" IS NOT NULL
      ) OR (
        "reasoning_nodes"."current_state" = 'skipped'
        AND "reasoning_nodes"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "reasoning_nodes"."output_hash" IS NULL
      )
